school.school_name: 東京医療秘書歯科衛生＆IT専門学校

manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Preserve the Tokyo official-index Sanko disclosure case where the latest visible confirmation form is still FY2025.
steps: Start from the Tokyo official-index URL registered as https://www.sanko.ac.jp/tokyo-med/disclosure/.
Follow the canonical Sanko disclosure page https://www.sanko.ac.jp/disclosure/tokyo-med/.
Inspect the 修学支援新制度 confirmation-form area before SERP fallback.
Observe that the latest target-form candidate is yoshiki2025.pdf with anchor text 2025年度.
Reject the PDF from strict FY2026 success as fiscal_year_mismatch:2025 and keep the school in publication-lag/operator-reviewable status.

reusable_rules: Treat 2025年度/yoshiki2025.pdf as latest-public target-form evidence, not as FY2026 success.
Use official-index SchoolSite URLs first and preserve the rejection evidence for operator publication-lag review.
Do not count Sanko pages with only yoshiki2025.pdf as crawler failures when the target-form candidate is visible but stale.
anti_patterns: Do not infer FY2026 from the current system target year when the actual link says 2025年度.
Do not accept stale forms just to improve the strict auto-yield metric.
Do not treat non-target disclosure PDFs on the same Sanko page as confirmation-form candidates.

evidence.notes: Source-side v348 Tokyo 20-site strict discovery repeat crawled this official-index disclosure page, found yoshiki2025.pdf, and rejected it as fiscal_year_mismatch:2025 for target FY2026.
